featured_reviews.name: Rahul Ranka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with the service. The cleaners were extremely slow, not that they cleant everything or every corner. Reason being they were untrained. Kept talking to each other. Kept teaching eachother.

several areas were still dirty even after they left. I had to redo parts of the cleaning myself. Maid had to clean even the windows from outside again. It was only done from inside. Wet wiping of walls was included. But they randomly left some areas without cleaning. Dining table they did from abv, when i checked it was completely dirty from below.

Definitely not worth it. Inhouse maid cleans better at half the price.

featured_reviews.name: Shishpal Rana
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently booked an apartment cleaning service, and the team of Abhishek, Arul, Nabeesh, and Arvind did an excellent job. They arrived on time, were polite and professional, and worked efficiently throughout the cleaning. Each of them paid great attention to detail — from dusting and scrubbing to organizing and ensuring every corner was spotless.

I appreciated how well-coordinated they were as a team, and they made sure to check in with me to confirm that everything was done to my satisfaction. My apartment looks fresh, clean, and so much brighter now.

Overall, I’m very satisfied with their service and would definitely recommend this team for anyone looking for a thorough and reliable cleaning service.

⸻
